experiment.name: Diagram change strategy selection
experiment.description:
Baseline of the original four decision rules, using the seven ChangeSession v2 AgentContexts saved November 3, 2026. Three independent samples per case (21 total), gpt-6-sol/high. Output: the Proposed diagram changes ASCII tree only. Decision thresholds are unchanged; input access is adapted to pinned snapshots and the output contract is explicit. Deterministic syntax and strategy-count assessment is separate from generation; no architectural quality score or target strategy frequency.

Phase 2 adds seven derived contexts and 21 planned outputs using revised visible strategy rules. It separates patch versus redraw decisions from existing versus new canvas decisions, judges cumulative changes per diagram, and removes the rule to exhaust [1a]/[1b]/[2]/[3] before redraw along with historical N-detail diagram plans. Both prompt and input changed, so phase comparisons describe observed outcomes rather than an isolated prompt effect.

phases.name: Baseline
phases.description: Original decision rules; tree-only output. Seven pinned contexts × three samples. Generation awaits review. The deterministic judgement is planned and must be run separately after generation; it parses tags and reports format errors without repairing outputs.

phases.name: Phase 2 · revised strategy
phases.description: Seven derived contexts × three independent samples, gpt-6-sol/high, session context delivery. The visible prompt first decides patch versus redraw for each existing diagram using cumulative changes, then decides existing versus new canvas for additional detail. The rule to exhaust [1a]/[1b]/[2]/[3] before redraw and historical N-detail diagram plans are removed. Prompt and input context both changed from baseline, so this comparison is descriptive rather than an isolated causal test. Generation and deterministic assessment require separate review.

phases.name: Astra high · unchanged Phase 2 prompt
phases.description: Same exact Phase 2 prompt v1 and the same seven pinned derived AgentContexts. Two independent samples per context (14 outputs), gpt-6-astra/high, session context delivery. Only the model and sample count change from Phase 2; no architectural-review recommendations or formatting repairs were added to the prompt. Deterministic parser v1 has its own phase assessment.

phases.name: Explicit architectural fit · astra high
phases.description: Same seven pinned contexts, astra/high, two independent samples per context (14 outputs), session context delivery. Only the prompt changes from Phase 3: require structural necessity for redraw, compare a new canvas with the closest existing canvas, prefer the smaller change when equally explanatory, and balance the example. Example explanatory sentences remain on one line for existing parser compatibility. No frequency targets, context edits or output repairs.

conditions.name: Original decision rules
conditions.description: No prompt-strengthening or strategy-frequency target. Same gpt-6-sol/high settings for every sample.

conditions.name: Revised strategy and derived contexts
conditions.description: Prompt variation from baseline v3 and freshly derived AgentContexts. Historical diagram assignments and preselected detail-diagram plans are superseded by visible instructions. Model and sampling match baseline.

conditions.name: Revised strategy · astra high
conditions.description: Reuses the Phase 2 prompt and contexts unchanged; gpt-6-astra at high effort with two samples per context.

conditions.name: Explicit architectural fit · astra high
conditions.description: Four approved prompt refinements; same inputs, model, effort, sample count and session delivery as Phase 3.

comparisons.name: Strategy selection and tree syntax
comparisons.description: Parser v1: validates the root, canvas labels, branch hierarchy and operation tags; counts [1a], [1b], [2], [3], [4] and output incidence for 3/4. Retains raw text and line-level errors, including recognized operations in invalid trees. Does not judge structural correctness, coverage, attachment validity or whether 3/4 should have been chosen.

comparisons.name: Phase 2 strategy selection and tree syntax
comparisons.description: Deterministic diagram-change-tree parser v1, scoped only to Phase 2 outputs. Validates tree syntax and counts [1a], [1b], [2], [3], [4]. Reports errors and raw operations without repairing outputs or judging architectural correctness.

comparisons.name: Phase 3 strategy selection and tree syntax
comparisons.description: Same deterministic diagram-change-tree parser v1 as prior phases. Counts strategy choices and reports syntax errors without judging architectural correctness. Failed generations must be explicitly excluded from any partial assessment.

comparisons.name: Phase 4 strategy selection and tree syntax
comparisons.description: Same deterministic diagram-change-tree parser v1. Report syntax and operation counts; assess architectural fit separately with the same criteria as Phases 2 and 3. Explicitly identify failed outputs if a partial assessment is needed.
